tv.sturm_tempo.grund: The opponent plays long balls to fast strikers: drop the back line so nothing gets in behind.
tv.sturm_tempo.nutzen: Less space behind our line, through balls fizzle out.
tv.sturm_tempo.risiko: The opponent gets more room in midfield; our attack sits further from goal.
tv.sturm_tempo.risiko_langsam: Our centre-backs are not quick (pace %1): watch the fast defenders and drop the line even deeper.
tv.hohe_linie.grund: The opponent holds a high line with slow centre-backs: there is room behind them for counters.
tv.hohe_linie.nutzen: Through balls to our fast forwards find space.
tv.hohe_linie.risiko: Less possession; the opponent gets the ball more often.
tv.presst_hoch.grund: The opponent presses high and early, and our midfield is not especially secure on the ball (technique %1): build up long.
tv.presst_hoch.nutzen: We bypass his press and win space.
tv.presst_hoch.risiko: More turnovers from long balls, less control.
tv.presst_kaum.grund: The opponent builds up short and hardly presses: closing him down early takes away his rhythm.
tv.presst_kaum.nutzen: Wins high up the pitch, short routes to goal.
tv.presst_kaum.risiko: Costs energy; the defence sits further up.
tv.presst_kaum.risiko_mued: The squad's fitness is only %1: closing down early costs energy and the team may fade late on.
tv.fluegel.grund: The opponent attacks down fast wings: stand wider and shut down the flanks.
tv.fluegel.nutzen: Fewer crosses and dribbles down the sides.
tv.zentrum.grund: The opponent plays through the middle with a technically strong midfield: tighten up.
tv.zentrum.nutzen: Short distances, fewer gaps in the centre.
tv.gegner_eng.grund: The opponent defends narrow and compact: attack down the wings and pull his middle apart.
tv.gegner_eng.risiko: Crosses against tall defenders are harder.
tv.gegner_weit.grund: The opponent stands spread out: play through the middle.
tv.gegner_weit.risiko: Little width in our own play.
tv.kondition.grund: The squad's fitness is only %1: aggressive pressing would drain them early.
tv.kondition.nutzen: More energy for the closing stages.
tv.kondition.risiko: The opponent gets more time on the ball.
tv.standards.grund: The opponent is strong at set pieces: avoid fouls near the box and mark tight (a hint, not a slider).
tv.standards.nutzen: Fewer dangerous free kicks and corners.
tv.dreierkette.grund: The opponent plays a back three: watch the flanks and the space behind the wing-backs (formation hint, not a slider).
tv.dreierkette.nutzen: Use the space behind the wide men.
tv.ui.laedt: The assistant manager is sizing up the opponent …
tv.ui.leer: Against this opponent the assistant manager sees nothing to change.
tv.ui.kein_gegner: No opponent in sight: nothing to advise.
tv.ui.hinweis: Suggestions for the draft only. Nothing reaches the game until you apply it yourself.
tv.ui.coach.schwach: Your assistant manager is tactically weak: his advice is uncertain.
tv.ui.coach.solide: Your assistant manager gives sound advice.
tv.ui.coach.stark: Your assistant manager has a good tactical eye.
